text: busy 1919 city street on a mild winter day, horse hooves clopping on cobblestones, wooden wagon wheels, crowd murmur, a distant streetcar bell, seagulls far away, no cars honking, no music
thick sticky syrup slowly oozing and dripping down a metal wall, slow viscous drips and gloopy squelches, close, quiet
wide paintbrush making a few slow strokes of thick paint across a steel plate, close, bristles dragging
old mechanical pocket watch ticking close up, steady quiet ticks
deep low ominous rumble slowly growing from beneath the ground, a huge steel structure straining, sub bass, building tension
steel rivets bursting out of a huge metal tank one after another in a rapid rattling burst like machine gun fire, sharp metallic pings and cracks, ricochets
enormous steel tank tearing open, a massive metallic rip and deep boom followed by a gushing roar of thick liquid
a towering wave of thick heavy liquid roaring down a city street, deep sloshing rumble, wood cracking and debris tumbling inside it
wooden buildings being crushed and torn off their foundations, timber splintering and collapsing, heavy crash
steel girders of an elevated railway bending and screeching under a massive impact, metal groaning and snapping
a single low somber sustained cinematic tone, dark and quiet, slowly fading, mournful
people slowly wading through thick sticky mud, heavy squelching steps, struggling, wet suction sounds, distant muffled shouts, cold outdoor air
very slow thick viscous liquid settling and congealing, soft deep gloops and creaks, quiet cold wind
hot summer afternoon on a 1930s city street, children playing and laughing far away, a distant ice cream bell, pigeons, gentle crowd murmur, no cars, no music
